ExtAttrs.description: Extensible attributes associated with the object.

acme_certificate_url.description: ACME certificate URL from which the issued certificate was fetched.

acme_order_url.description: ACME order URL for this certificate.

cert_use.description: Intended use of the certificate (denormalized from profile).

managed_by.description: How the certificate currently occupying this certificate's (member, cert_use) slot is provisioned: ACME (still managed by this ACME certificate) or MANUAL (the slot has been overwritten by a manual certificate upload since this certificate was issued).

member.description: Grid member this certificate is bound to (denormalized from profile).

member_name.description: Grid member host name (denormalized from member). A searchable string mirror of the member reference: object references support only exact search (search='='), so this plain string field is what lets the ACME Certificates grid filter members with the full string operator set (begins with / does not begin with / equals / contains), the same way 'subject' does.

next_renewal_time.description: Computed time of the next scheduled renewal.

profile.description: Reference to the certificate profile that governs this certificate.

profile_name.description: Certificate profile name (denormalized from profile). Searchable string mirror of the profile reference, for the same reason as member_name.

renewal_attempts.description: Number of consecutive renewal attempts in the current cycle.

serial_number.description: Serial number of this certificate, in hex.

subject_alt_names.description: Certificate Subject Alternative Names, comma-separated. Modern ACME CAs (Let's Encrypt/Boulder, Pebble) issue leaf certificates with an empty Subject DN and convey identity via SAN only, so 'subject' above is legitimately blank for them; this field is where that identity information actually lives.

acme_server.description: The name of the ACME server used for certificate operations. Also accepts the ACME server's '_ref'.

acme_server_name.description: ACME server name (denormalized from acme_server). Searchable string mirror of the acme_server reference (object references support only exact search), so the ACME Certificate Profiles grid can filter by ACME server with the full string operator set. Kept in sync with acme_server on create and update.

auto_renewal_enabled.description: Enable or disable automatic certificate renewal.

challenge_type.description: ACME challenge type used for domain validation.

comment.description: Descriptive comment for this ACME certificate profile.

common_name.description: Common name (CN) for the certificate subject. Required at creation, matching the WebUI wizard's existing requirement (NIOSRFE-10409) -- a profile always has a usable identifier as soon as it's created; additional names can still be added afterward via ``update_sans``.

csr_pinned.description: True when a CSR is pinned on this profile (i.e. ``pinned_csr_pem`` is non-empty). Useful for filtering profiles that have a pinned CSR in list requests.

disabled.description: Enable or disable this certificate profile.

dns_propagation_delay.description: Seconds to wait after provisioning the DNS-01 TXT record before notifying the CA that it should validate the challenge. Allows tuning per-profile for environments with slow DNS propagation. Range 0–300. Default 20. Applies to DNS-01 challenge only. HTTP-01 profiles always return null/None for this field.

dns_view.description: NIOS DNS view in which the DNS-01 challenge TXT record should be created. Applies to DNS-01 challenge only. Empty/unset uses the default view.

expiry_warning_days.description: Number of days before certificate expiry at which the widest expiry-warning trap/email begins firing (0..365). Fixed 7-day and 1-day reminders also fire once the certificate falls inside this window. Set to 0 to disable expiry warnings for this profile entirely, including the 7-day and 1-day reminders. Default 30.

key_algorithm.description: Key algorithm for the certificate key pair.

key_size.description: Key size in bits (e.g. 2048, 4096 for RSA; 256, 384 for ECDSA).

last_error.description: Error message from the last failed operation, if any.

last_renewal_attempt.description: Timestamp of the most recent renewal attempt.

member.description: Grid member for which this certificate profile applies. Also accepts the member object's '_ref'.

name.description: Unique name for this ACME certificate profile.

pending_order_url.description: ACME order URL of an in-flight issuance, persisted so the renewal scheduler can resume from ``poll_authorizations`` after a daemon restart instead of issuing a fresh ``newOrder``. Cleared automatically on completion; operators normally do not edit this field.

pinned_csr_common_name.description: Subject common name (CN) parsed from ``pinned_csr_pem``. Empty when no CSR is pinned or the pinned CSR has no CN.

pinned_csr_key_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint (colon-separated uppercase hex) of the public key in ``pinned_csr_pem``. Empty when no CSR is pinned.

pinned_csr_pem.description: Optional pinned CSR PEM. When set, the manager skips CSR regeneration on every renewal and resubmits these bytes verbatim. Use the ``pin_csr`` function call to set or clear this field; reading it back returns the persisted bytes.

pinned_csr_sans.description: Subject Alternative Names parsed from ``pinned_csr_pem``, as a list of strings. Empty when no CSR is pinned.

prefer_chain.description: Issuer Common Name substring (case-insensitive) used to select a preferred alternative certificate chain when the CA offers more than one (RFC 8555 Section 7.4.2). When set the manager fetches all alternate chains advertised by the CA and picks the first chain in which any certificate's issuer CN contains this substring. Empty string keeps the CA default chain.

renewal_window_days.description: Number of days before certificate expiry at which to trigger a fixed-day renewal, honored only when ``use_renewal_window_days`` is true. Must be 1..365 in any create or update that supplies this field while the resulting mode is fixed-days (whether or not that same call also switches the toggles); 0 is rejected in that case. When ``use_renewal_window_percentage`` is true instead, supplying this field always resets it to 0 regardless of the value sent. Defaults to 0.

renewal_window_percentage.description: Percentage of certificate lifetime at which automatic renewal is triggered (1..99).

status.description: Lifecycle status of this certificate profile.

subject_alternative_names.description: Subject Alternative Names (SANs) currently configured on this profile, each an object with ``type`` (``DNS``, ``IP``, ``URI``, or ``EMAIL``) and ``value``. Use the ``update_sans`` function call to set or clear SANs.

use_renewal_window_days.description: When true, ``renewal_window_days`` governs renewal timing. Mutually exclusive with ``use_renewal_window_percentage``: exactly one of the two must be true. Defaults to false.

use_renewal_window_percentage.description: When true, ``renewal_window_percentage`` governs renewal timing. Mutually exclusive with ``use_renewal_window_days``: exactly one of the two must be true. Defaults to true.

details.description: Additional context: order URL, challenge type, certificate serial, or other operation-specific information.

error_message.description: Error detail when status is FAILURE. Empty on success.

member.description: Grid member this log entry is associated with (denormalized from profile).

operation_type.description: Free-form string describing the type of operation. Common values include ENROLL, RENEW, REVOKE, ENROLL_BEGIN, CERTIFICATE_ISSUED, DEPLOY, RENEW_SUCCESS, RENEW_FAILED, EXPIRY_WARNING, EXPIRED, PERMANENT_FAILURE, MANUAL_OVERRIDE, and RESET_FOR_REENROLLMENT. New values may be added without a schema change.

operator_name.description: Username of the operator who initiated the action, if known.

profile.description: Reference to the certificate profile this log entry belongs to.

timestamp.description: Time at which the operation was recorded.

account_deactivated_time.description: Timestamp of ACME account deactivation, if applicable.

account_email.description: Contact email address for the ACME account registered with this server.

account_key_rotation_enabled.description: Enable automatic periodic rotation of the ACME account key.

account_key_rotation_interval_days.description: Interval, in days, between automatic ACME account key rotations. Only used when ``account_key_rotation_enabled`` is true. Valid range is 1 to 365 days.

account_key_type.description: Key algorithm used for the ACME account key.

account_status.description: Lifecycle status of the ACME account registered with this server. Set to ``DEACTIVATED`` only via the ``deactivate_account`` function call; cannot be set directly. Defaults to ``ACTIVE``.

account_uri.description: Account URI returned by the ACME server after registration.

ca_cert.description: Reference to a CA certificate trusted when validating this ACME server's TLS certificate. Required for private servers whose root is not in the system trust store.

comment.description: Descriptive comment for this ACME server configuration.

directory_url.description: ACME directory endpoint URL. Defaults to ``server_url`` when not set.

disabled.description: Enable or disable this ACME server configuration.

eab_hmac_key.description: External Account Binding HMAC key, base64url-encoded. Required when ``external_account_binding`` is true. Stored encrypted.

eab_kid.description: External Account Binding key identifier. Required when ``external_account_binding`` is true.

external_account_binding.description: Enable External Account Binding (EAB) for ACME providers that require it (RFC 8555 §7.3.4).

last_key_rotation.description: Timestamp of the most recent ACME account key rotation (manual or automatic).

name.description: Unique name for this ACME server configuration.

server_type.description: Whether this is a public or private ACME server.

server_url.description: Base URL of the ACME server (typically the directory endpoint, e.g. ``https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory``).
